Label: SMSC - Questionnaire on Behaviour in Social Situations
Description: SMSC - Questionnaire on Behaviour in Social Situations (SMSC). Measures self-monitoring in social situations (e.g. acting, other-directedness). 35 items, true/false. Authors: Gernot von Collani, Stefan Stürmer (2009). License: CC BY-SA 4.0 (Open Test Archive, ZPID).
